card.name: Suicidality warning words and heading connectors
card.fires_on: Mainly the middle of the word suicidal ideation or thoughts (IDE-ATION, THO-UGHT) in boxed warning headings. Also fires on linking words in section headings like Switching from or Transferring Patients.

modes.label: Suicidality warning
modes.description: Later pieces of ideation or thoughts in the all-caps suicidal ideation warning title.
modes.example: WARNING: SUICIDAL IDE<<ATION>> IN CHILDREN AND ADOLESC

modes.label: Heading connectors
modes.description: Small words in section titles about switching or transferring therapy, or in dose-related phrases.

card.plain: It lights up inside the suicidal ideation boxed warning title and on small connecting words in drug label headings.
